g0.reason: The implementation/control baseline can be frozen, but operational execution and publication evidence required for a trustworthy G0 pass do not yet exist.

observatory_data.note: The commit that merges this baseline will necessarily post-date the observed pre-baseline S2 main and is not self-referentially embedded here.

observatory_v2_migration_gate_a.boundary: Mechanical Gate-A completion is representational engineering evidence only. It is not G0, publication authorization, substantive truth, native graph completeness, or institutional approval.

publication_state.boundary: Software capability to create, authorize, verify, and serve a published release does not mean that a graph-native Observatory-v2 release has been authorized or published.

scheduled_operational_live_due_cycle.interpretation: No collector failure or success is inferred because the validation job did not execute workflow steps.

scheduled_successor_discovery.interpretation: Failure is recorded; no root cause or collector verdict is inferred here without step-level execution evidence.

scheduled_current_monitor_accountability.interpretation: Continued scheduled failure corroborates that operational health has not been re-established.

push_triggered_operational_live_corrobor.interpretation: This is corroborating pre-runner evidence only and is not a substitute for a fresh scheduled due-cycle.

residual_content_safety_boundary.description: The live-shadow scheduler path has the dual authorization gate and hardened transport controls but does not currently execute through the EvidenceCollectionService content-safety scanning facade.

blockers.description: Hosted runner execution is not restored; issue #105 remains open and fresh scheduled workflows continue to fail.
No fresh controlled live acquisition has executed under the exact current Workbench dual network-authorization gate.
The live-shadow content-safety scanning boundary requires deliberate resolution and verification before production-readiness can be claimed.
No graph-native Observatory-v2 S2 candidate-to-authorization-to-publication operation has been performed.
The workflow pin reconciliation in this baseline branch cannot be claimed hosted-validated until a runner executes its steps.

reconsider_g0_when: A hosted runner executes and retains step-level/log evidence.
A fresh scheduled operational live due-cycle validates successfully and reaches collector execution.
A controlled live acquisition executes under the exact current Workbench pin with verified dual authorization.
The live-shadow content-safety boundary is explicitly resolved and verified.
Publication-state requirements for the intended G0 definition are satisfied or explicitly scoped as a later gate without ambiguity.
boundary: This baseline freezes the observed execution state with blockers. It does not authorize publication, establish scientific truth, establish global or source-universe completeness, establish system conformance, establish operational health, or constitute a G0 pass.
